items.title: Use query statistics to find slow and expensive queries in Aurora DSQL
items.summary: When a code change slows your application, Amazon Aurora DSQL query statistics help you find the slow and expensive queries behind it, down to the exact SQL statement. This post walks through a performance investigation that pinpoints a missing index, fixes it with an asynchronous index build, and measures the improvement in latency and DPU cost.
items.creator: Rakesh Reddy Kondakindi
